svg.title: Sheet 4 of 6, detail C, AI systems, with an illustrated run that moves through five phases, Spec, Red, Green, Review and Memory, while the hook blocks one call outside its phase and every step is added to a chained ledger that a verify script checks line by line: RATCHET, a gated pipeline for IBM Bob, an AI coding agent. Top 50: one of the 50 top-scoring qualified submissions, with no rank given; 8 of 8 hidden referee tests passed by the gated run, one run with one seed, an illustration, not a benchmark; 52 ledger records verified, tamper-evident, not tamper-proof. Sole developer; IBM TechXchange 2026 Pre-conference Dev Day Hackathon; Python, pytest and bandit; August 2026.
